
```json
[
  {
    "id": "TC-001",
    "title": "Edit/Update Chemist/Lab Details",
    "req_ids": ["VCMCL03-1", "VCMCL03-2", "VCMCL03-3"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Chemist/Lab exists", "User is logged in"],
    "inputs": {"chemist_lab_id": "valid_id", "chemist_lab_name": "new_name", "address": "new_address", "contact": "new_contact"},
    "steps": ["Navigate to Chemist/Lab screen", "Enter details", "Submit changes"],
    "expected": ["Details updated and displayed"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-002",
    "title": "Error when Chemist/Lab does not exist",
    "req_ids": ["VCMCL03-2"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["User is logged in", "Chemist/Lab does not exist"],
    "inputs": {"chemist_lab_id": "invalid_id"},
    "steps": ["Navigate to Chemist/Lab screen", "Enter details", "Submit changes"],
    "expected": ["Error message displayed 'Chemist or Lab does not exist'"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-003",
    "title": "Check for open prescription requests before deletion",
    "req_ids": ["VCMCL03-3"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["User is logged in", "Chemist/Lab exists", "Open prescription requests exist"],
    "inputs": {"chemist_lab_id": "valid_id"},
    "steps": ["Navigate to Chemist/Lab screen", "Select delete", "Confirm deletion"],
    "expected": ["Error message displayed 'Chemist or Lab has open Prescription Requests - cannot delete'"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-004",
    "title": "Administrators Add Symptom Code",
    "req_ids": ["VCMSYM01"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["User is logged in", "Administrator role"],
    "inputs": {"symptom_code": "new_code", "symptom_description": "new_description"},
    "steps": ["Navigate to Symptom Code screen", "Enter details", "Submit changes"],
    "expected": ["Symptom Code saved and displayed"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-005",
    "title": "Edit/Update Symptom Description",
    "req_ids": ["VCMSYM03"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["User is logged in", "Administrator role"],
    "inputs": {"symptom_code": "existing_code", "symptom_description": "new_description"},
    "steps": ["Navigate to Symptom screen", "Enter details", "Submit changes"],
    "expected": ["Symptom Description updated"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-006",
    "title": "Update Patient Profile",
    "req_ids": ["VCDPA02"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["User is logged in", "Patient exists"],
    "inputs": {"patient_id": "valid_id", "consultation_request": "new_request"},
    "steps": ["Navigate to Patient Profile screen", "Enter details", "Submit changes"],
    "expected": ["Patient Profile updated"]
  }
]
```
